📖 How to use

  1. Enter the total distance you swam in meters.
  2. Enter your total swim time in minutes and seconds.
  3. Press Calculate.
  4. Compare your pace per 100m and per 100 yards.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I enter pool distance?

Most pools are 25m or 50m. Enter the total distance you swam in meters — e.g. 1500 for 60 lengths of a 25m pool.

What is pace per 100m?

Divide your total time by the number of 100m segments you swam. This tool does it automatically.

Why are the 100m and 100yd paces different?

100 yards equals 91.44 meters, so a 100-yard pace is slightly faster (shorter time) than a 100m pace.
